scope: Alternating baseline/candidate, identical guest programs and fresh cloned app stores; warm caches on a shared host; affinity recorded, frequency not controlled. CoreMark default single-thread -O2. Apps use the same complete hybrid musl, pure routing, allocator routing off. CoreMark and static CPU/SMP fixtures use their original libc. QEMU host timings, when selected, test ARM64 code generation, not device speed.
